correctness.rationale: The proof excludes all one-sign periodic states via nonzero weighted forcing, reduces every two-crossing periodic state to one strictly decreasing integral zero via monotonicity of D-C, constructs the unique antiperiodic orbit, computes its exact Floquet integral and global basin by an increasing one-fixed-point period map. Uniform two-endpoint Laplace expansions and a simple limiting root prove the O(a^-3) crossing and O(a^-2) multiplier errors. Numerical checker succeeded but finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The orthogonal sine/cosine forcing is a canonical explicit special case within a first-harmonic family with only coarse general cycle bounds. The exact all-nonzero-parameter periodic classification, global basin dichotomy and strictly positive nontrivial limiting Floquet constant expose a sharp singular amplitude effect of demonstrable use in understanding these forced switching dynamics.
